permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Voice to Groq, questions to Gemini, weather and air quality from Open-Meteo, exchange rates, maps and places from Esri and OpenStreetMap, walking routes from OSRM, facts and news from Wikipedia, DuckDuckGo and Hacker News, and notifications via ntfy.sh.

permissions.desc: Shows where you are on the map, gives walking directions, finds nearby places for radar and place reminders, and gives local weather.
